name: Iori
message: 「...All right, check complete. All green.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you very much, Iori-sensei.」
Once I finished the final pre-match check, Asahi gave me a small bow.
Her expression, however, wasn't bright.

name: Iori
message: 「Are you okay, Asahi？ You've got a scary look on your face.」

name: Asahi
message: 「My apologies. It seems I'm uncharacteristically nervous.」
...That's not really the look I'm seeing, though.

name: Iori
message: 「Could it be because your opponent is Arakawa-san？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm competing in the Martial Festival to become the Toujinegi. It makes no difference who my opponent is.」

name: Iori
message: 「You're bothered about Ririmu, aren't you？」
Her expression stiffened once again.

name: Asahi
message: 「...She said, 'In the world of competition, once you lose, anything you say is just the howling of a beaten dog.'」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then I'll win and shut that arrogant mouth of hers.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi...」
A fierce resolve dwelt in Asahi's eyes.
It was as if roaring, surging flames—fierce enough to scorch her very body—were enveloping Asahi.

name: Iori
message: 「...Asahi, you have the genuine skill it takes to defeat Arakawa Sonomi.」

name: Iori
message: 「So I'm not worried about that at all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, sometimes you let your emotions get the better of you and lose sight of everything around you.」
Asahi's eyes darted away. Looks like she's aware of it herself.

name: Iori
message: 「Try to remember back when you and Ririmu argued and had that all-out sparring match.」

name: Iori
message: 「Through that match, you and Ririmu became close. Ririmu saved you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Perhaps you're right.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, don't let fury cloud your eyes. You must not become a demon.」

name: Iori
message: 「Please, take this to heart. You... must never become like me.」
This wasn't an order, nor was it a plea. It was simply a prayer.
Whether that prayer reached her—

name: Asahi
message: 「...Understood.」
Asahi gave a small, firm nod.

name: Umpire
message: 「To the West—Martial Arts Division Year 1, Special Class A 'Takamura Class' member! Kuki, Asahiーーーーーーーーーーーーーー!!」
As Asahi's name was called, we both turned our eyes toward the entrance.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Well then, Iori-sensei, I'm going.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, know your opponent well, and look at what lies beyond them.」

name: Iori
message: 「And make sure you find something...！」
I could hear the cheers. But to me, that was irrelevant.
Standing before me in the East was my fated opponent.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ha, what a scary look on your face.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「The crowd's making all this noise just for you. Why don't you try smiling and being a little charming?」
I could hear the sound of blood rushing to my head. Everything she said was infuriating.

name: Asahi
message: 「...You haven't forgotten our promise, have you？ If I win, you will lower your head to Ririmu-san.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hmph, I don't recall making any promises.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I'll just beat you into the ground and be done with it. After that, you can do whatever you want with yourself.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...The winner takes all, and the loser merely bows in submission. That is your way of doing things, isn't it?」

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case, I shall follow your way—I'll grind your face into the dirt until you're bowing before me...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Try it if you think you can, first-year.」

name: Umpire
message: 「Both sides, take your stances！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh! A restless air is drifting between the two. It seems there's some bad blood here, but...」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That's what I'm talking about！ Jindou isn't just about clashing Origami; it's about clashing with your passion！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Beat the hell out of each other！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now, for this highly anticipated third match of the first round, a clash of blades and spirits！ What kind of conclusion will we see！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Gather the eight million gods in the Divine Assembly, deliberate in the Divine Council. Heaven and earth are pure, the six senses are cleansed; purify them, cleanse them...！」

name: Umpire
message: 「On the East side, Arakawa Sonomi！」

name: Umpire
message: 「On the West side, Kuki Asahi！」

name: Umpire
message: 「—Bagua ascending, assume your stances, no delays！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Prepare yourselves, begin the match！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Right then, here I come！」
With a fearless grin, she swung her Origami up.
And just like that, she charged toward me—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ngh-yaaaaah！」

name: Asahi
message: （She’s not coming in...？ Coming from the outside...!？）
Just as I thought she was going to rush me, she held the hilt by the end and unleashed a long-range sweep.
I instinctively jumped back to dodge it, and she immediately closed the distance again.
However―she stopped just before entering my range, unleashing another long―range attack.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, hey! Come on!」
I parried the tip of the attacking nagamaki and backed away again. And once more, she gave chase.
Stopping her feet at the very edge where my attacks couldn't reach her.

name: Sonomi
message: 「What’s the matter, is your Origami just for show！？ You won’t get anywhere if you keep it sheathed！」
Even while taunting me, she kept her spacing under strict control. Contrary to her rough demeanor, her fighting style was technical.

name: Asahi
message: （Though, I had already accounted for that...！）
A nagamaki is an all-around weapon that can fight both at long and short range.
And Arakawa-senpai is someone who understands those characteristics better than anyone and knows how to use them to her advantage.
I hadn't expected her to have calculated such thorough countermeasures from the very start, but even so, I knew this tactic was coming.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Urah！」
Once again, I parried a wide, sweeping blow and retreated.
Even just parrying her, I could easily feel her physical strength and the destructive power of her strikes.
In a way, that might be proof of her effort.

name: Asahi
message: （...Yes, I know. I know just how much you’ve trained day after day！）
I don’t know about Arakawa-senpai’s side of things, but I remember when we met at the dormitory entrance.
Just like me, she kept training until late into the night, burning with an extraordinary obsession for victory deep within her eyes.

name: Asahi
message: （But that’s true of Ririmu-san, too...！）
I couldn’t bring myself to like how she spoke, her appearance, or her personality. Even now, I feel like we’re fundamentally incompatible.
But still, she held unwavering convictions, and she continued the constant, exhausting effort to match them.
As her fellow student, I had watched that form of hers from up close.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Come on, what's wrong with you！? Was all that bluster just empty talk at the start！?」
A thorough long―range offensive―proof that she had properly studied and countered my fighting style and its reach.
It was also proof of Arakawa-senpai’s obsession with victory.
However—！

name: Asahi
message: 「Don't think my reach will stay the same forever...！」
I kick off the ground hard and close the distance myself.
I won't give her a moment to dodge. Just like that—！

name: Sonomi
message: 「Guaaaagh！？」
Taking the full force of my flash strike, Arakawa-senpai tumbled to the ground.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It’s a hit！ A powerful strike that looks like it could have severed her torso right in two！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Asahi, who was being forced into a tough battle due to the reach difference, has launched an offensive here！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That wasn't some half-baked step-in, it was rock-solid. That right there is the fruit of some serious training！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The crowd is going wild！ Sonomi is still down！ Could it really end like this?！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Wait？ Asahi is taking up the Iai stance again, aimed at the fallen Sonomi！ What is this...？」

name: Asahi
message: 「...How long do you intend to lie there？ Please get up, it’s a waste of time」
I call out to Arakawa-senpai, who remains motionless on the ground.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Heh, I was planning to smash you when you came in for the follow-up, you know」
She gets up with an air of composure. As expected. There's no way it would end with just this.

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, I’d be troubled if that were the case」

name: Asahi
message: 「At the very least, I want you to grovel on the ground in front of me another hundred times and show me your pathetic figure」
I dare to flash a smile.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Tch, what an irritating first-year. Don't get cocky！」
She charges forward at a speed even greater than before, swinging not so much to cut as to collide her blade with mine.
As I parry it with my scabbard, she does something different than before; she steps even further forward, closing in on me.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Take this！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ngh... what happened to your counter-measures from before...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「If you're going to come charging at me, there's no point in me just waiting around, is there！？」
I dodge the blow aimed at dragging me into close quarters and leap back—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Don't run！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh…！」
The blade extended toward the spot where I jumped back. I managed to block it, but a tremendous impact pierced through my body.
She adjusts her reach so smoothly based on distance that it really feels like her blade is actually expanding and contracting.
In that sense, she might even be technically superior to Tennouji-senpai or Setsugekka-san.

name: Asahi
message: （Plus, she uses that immortality-like durability of hers to aim for a one-hit kill, completely disregarding the damage she takes—）

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ha, looks like you’ve lost that initial fire of yours！」
Parry. Endure.
If I make a careless move, she’ll just tank it with that durability of hers, and I’ll be the one getting countered.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Asahi-senshu has been forced into a defensive position after being pressured at close range！ She’s doing everything she can just to weather Sonomi-senshu’s rush！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Iai battou is super tough when your opponent is willing to risk a mutual strike just to get in your face！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「To fend that off, you need one-hit-kill attack power, but looking at what just happened, Sonomi doesn’t seem phased at all.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It looks like Asahi-senshu is being forced into a really grueling fight！ I’m hoping she can find a way to turn this around！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「What’s the matter, is this it? Is it over already?！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, show some guts, damn it！ If this is how it ends, I’m gonna be bored to death！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Guh…！」
Every time I intercept one of Arakawa-senpai’s blows, the shock is enough to shake my whole body, vibrating through my arms.
That strength, a result of pure effort and training, combined with high technical skill in handling such a long weapon.
If I let my guard down even a little, she’ll immediately drive a strike right into that opening—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch, you’re tough… huddling up like a damn clam！」

name: Asahi
message: （Endure, endure, and just keep enduring…………！）
The core of Iai battou is the decisive strike delivered the moment the opponent shows an opening.
That is precisely why, no matter how many hits I take, I must endure until that chance appears.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Damn it, then I’ll just have to pry you open…！！」
……It’s fine, it’s nothing I can’t handle.
No matter how heavy the strike, as long as I block it, my Barrier Jacket will take no damage.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Gotcha！！！」
Slipping past my defense, a strike delivered from a blinding spin.
Arakawa Senpai's skill is the real deal. She wields that nagamaki—good for both offense and defense—with absolute perfection.
Her immense strength allows her to swing that long weapon as easily as a toothpick, a high level of technique that speaks to her dedication.
If only she wouldn't open her mouth, she'd be a swordsman worthy of respect.

name: Asahi
message: （Still, because of that... she has almost zero openings...！）
Pressed by Arakawa Senpai’s fierce strikes and heavy blows, I am gradually forced to retreat.
If things go on like this, I might just be overwhelmed.
...Come to think of it, I've had a fight like this before. During sparring practice with Iori-sensei.
Back then, I couldn't do a thing against Iori―sensei either, but―
『Being cautious is a great strength, but sometimes you won't see a path to victory unless you're willing to take a gamble！』

name: Asahi
message: （...Hehe, that's right. I was indeed taught that, by Iori-sensei...！）

name: Sonomi
message: 「Take this！ And this！」
Even if I parry Arakawa Senpai’s attacks, another one comes flying at me immediately.
But... right. No matter how heavy her strikes are, there's no need to insist on taking zero damage.

name: Asahi
message: （When it comes to durability, I won't lose either...！）

name: Sonomi
message: 「If you intend to keep hiding away in there forever, I'll just smash the whole shell to pieces！！」
She launches another pursuit.
I respond, slightly exposing my flank and shifting my trunk a few centimeters back—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Gotcha！！！」
—Hooked！
In that instant, my koiguchi sets fire—！！

name: Asahi
message: 「Secret Technique, Ouitsu Issen—！！！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ngghaaaaaaahh...！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa! It’s a hit! Is this the true essence of an Iai draw!」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「She’s knocked Sonomi-senpai all the way to the edge of the stage！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Whoa... that’s some insane power！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sono-chan-senpai...！！」
Sono-chan-senpai lies still at the edge of the stage. Seeing that, I found myself standing up, worried.
However—from the surroundings, I hear completely different voices.

name: Spectator D
message: 「Ahaha, look at that！ Serves her right！」

name: Spectator E
message: 「That's the one, right? The one who acts like a lone wolf and gets all full of herself?」

name: Spectator F
message: 「I'm in her class, and she doesn't even show up to lessons or have any social skills. I don't know how she hasn't been expelled yet~」

name: Spectator D
message: 「Honestly, is she even strong? She’s just stubborn, right? She’s always getting beaten by all sorts of people.」

name: Spectator E
message: 「Right！ She’s just so… uncool, I guess? Like, she doesn't belong at the Martial Festival, you know?」

name: Spectator F
message: 「Go for it, freshman！ Take her down just like that！」
I instinctively clench my molars.
Those talking are probably classmates of Sono-chan. There are so many people here, I can’t tell who is who.

name: Spectator A
message: 「That’s it, Kuki Asahi！ Finish her off！！」

name: Spectator B
message: 「Finish it！」
Looking around, almost everyone was rooting for Asahi.
Aside from me, no one was worried about Sono―chan, and no one was cheering for her―.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……I know. That’s the role of a heel.」
Heels are expected to be beaten by everyone. That’s their role.
So, it’s unavoidable that people say bad things. I’m sure Sono-chan doesn't mind that.
But…… she’s definitely not uncool.
Sono-chan is clumsy; she’s just the kind of person who can only live life that way.
Even so, she doesn't care what others think of her. She’s someone who stays true to her own way of life.
That’s right, and that’s why.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sono-chan is incredibly cool……！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Gah, coff……！」

name: Sonomi
message: （That hit… it was way worse than I thought…）
The impact felt like being punched in the gut with everything they had. I might’ve cracked a few ribs.

name: Sonomi
message: （Damn it, I can’t think straight…！）
My vision is blurring, and my head is spinning wildly.

name: Sonomi
message: （Where’d that first-year brat go…？）
I search desperately through my blurred vision.

name: Sonomi
message: （What the hell is this? I can’t see a damn thing…）
I wipe my eyes and shake my head, but my consciousness only drifts further away.

name: Sonomi
message: （Yeah… I know, I know. Just gotta stand up and fight, right…？）
I force my numb limbs to move, trying desperately to stand. But it’s no use.
Only my impatience grows.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Guh, ughhh…！！」
Excruciating pain shoots through me at the slightest movement.
Suddenly, a roar of cheers erupts.
But that was all for the first-year brat—for Kuki—not me.

name: Sonomi
message: （Hah... I get it. I’m an outcast. I’m used to this sort of thing...！）
I’ve always fought and survived on my own. So being alone is perfectly—

name: Sonomi
message: （What is this, I can't put any power into it... Is it over...？ Is this as far as I go？）
...Well, fine then.
Nobody was hoping for me to get back up anyway—
「GRAAAAAAAAH!! What’s wrong, Sono-chan-senpai!!」
「Have you lost your edge-ahhhhhh!!」
Suddenly, a voice I recognized reached my ears.
Ah, that’s—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I thought the words of encouragement were especially nice, actually~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「'What’s wrong, you’ve lost your edge, go rush 'em！'」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, it’s good... seriously cool.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「No, that’s not encouragement, that’s just taunting.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh? But if you translate it, it means 'You’re better than this, please try harder,' right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Doesn't that sound like some serious cheering？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How long are you planning on sleeping there！！ Show me your guts and GO RUSH 'EM AAAAAAAHHH！！！！」
Her shouting voice pierced through my ears, louder than anything else.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ugh... ughhh... jeez, you’re noisy, you idiot！！」
But, it’s not bad.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Thanks to you, I’m wide awake now—！！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ooooooh! Contestant Sonomi is back on her feet!」
How much time had passed? Just a few seconds, maybe?
I couldn't tell, but the first-year was just about to leap at me.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Good morning, Arakawa-senpai. If you had slept any longer, the match would be over, you know？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That’s too bad for you...！」
I caught her blade, and we pushed against each other, our hilts locked.

name: Asahi
message: 「No, no, that’s not the case at all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because I can just beat you down again and force you to your knees...！！」
...You know, you’re actually more ill-natured than I am, aren't you.

name: Sonomi
message: 「YRAAAARGHHHH！！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh... you littleeee...！！！」
—In the center of the stage, the two were locked in a fierce exchange of blows.
Even Sonomi, who once looked completely beaten, was lunging in with terrifying intensity.
No matter how many attacks she took, she wouldn't fall. It was as if no attack could truly reach her.

name: Asahi
message: 「Gotcha！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Gahhh！」
Asahi’s counter lands clean.
Yet, Sonomi stumbles but finds her footing—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Not yet, this ain't gonna cut ittt！！」
Recovering her stance instantly, she pounces on Asahi like a wild animal.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh, ngh...！！」
And a battle like this had been going on for a long time now.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And for the umpteenth time, Asahi-senshu absorbs Sonomi-senshu’s counterattack and manages to push her back！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「But this is... truly a staggering spectacle.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The clock shows we are already twenty minutes into the match！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Now this is one hell of a match...！ If this were the pros, they’d call a timeout for sure, or it’d end in a draw.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「And neither of them will back down from the center of the stage！ I want those gutless pros to see this！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It has become an otherworldly match like nothing we’ve ever seen！ The audience is a mix of roaring cheers and gasps！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「RAAAHHH！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Guh…！」
They trade strikes, glaring at each other—.
Sonomi's greatest strength is, as expected, her abnormal stamina. She corners her opponents and eventually crushes them with sheer brute force.
Of course, Asahi possesses extraordinary stamina as well.
She pushed herself to the absolute limit, trained relentlessly, and gained the strength befitting a war of attrition.

name: Iori
message: （Even so... every time Asahi takes a hit, her stamina and mental strength are being chipped away.）
On the other hand, every time Sonomi takes a hit, her resolve and the pressure she exerts only grow.
The gap between them only widens the longer the match goes on—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Get blown away, you little brat！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh no, Asahi...！！」
Was it a lapse in strength, or simply being overpowered—
The strike Arakawa-san swung knocked Asahi's guard aside, leaving her completely defenseless.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Right here！！ Get crushed！！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Gyaaaaaaaah！！」
Taking a fierce blow sweeping across her torso, Asahi let out a loud scream—
and was sent flying spectacularly.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Sigh. What am I even doing?」
Looking up at the stadium makes a sigh slip out. It was an awful place, a place I didn't want to see.
Ever since the Martial Festival preliminaries ended right up until today, I'd been holed up all alone in my dorm room.
Even when I tried heading over to the mainland for a change of pace, it didn't hype me up one bit.
And now, here I am, standing right in front of this stadium I couldn't even stand to lay eyes on.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...I wonder why.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Because it felt frustrating, like I was running away...？ Because I wanted to watch strong people fight and learn from them...？」
I try coming up with all sorts of reasons, but... nope.
More than anything, it's probably—

name: Ririmu
message: 「I guess I just wanted to see everyone fight...」
...Ever since I ran away from home, I've always lived just the way I wanted.
Not even being able to make decisions about your own life—that's just totally crazy.
So I decide everything about myself. To me, my own worldview is the standard for everything.
I thought that was fine. I didn't care what anyone else thought—or so I believed.

name: Ririmu
message: （But being in Takamura Class, being together with everyone... maybe I've started changing, little by little.）
It's not like my worldview changed. It's not like my way of living changed, either.
It's just that doing Jindou with Sensei and everyone else was plain fun.
That's why I'd started wanting to keep it going.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...I bet it's all Sensei's fault~」
I even became friends with Asahi, someone I thought I could never possibly see eye to eye with.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi...」
Since that day my elimination in the preliminaries was decided, when I got mad at Asahi, I haven't seen her once.
Asahi got angry for my sake. She tried to protect me, desperately sticking up for me.
And yet I took my frustration out on her.
I've regretted it ever since.
But I didn't know what to say to Asahi, and I just couldn't work up the courage.
Cheers echo out from the stadium. Someone's probably in the middle of a match right now.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Secchan, Momitchi, Asahi...」
While the three of them are fighting with all their might, I’m just wandering around aimlessly in a place like this, not even showing my face.
Honestly, I was scared to watch the broadcast.
On one hand, I didn't want them to lose, but on the other... if they did lose... my companions would increase.
I hate that I think such things, I hate it so much, so I tried not to think about it as much as possible.

name: Ririmu
message: 「But still... I guess I have to watch...」
Fearfully, I fire up the holographic display. Then, turning my face away, I take a peek from the corner of my eye—

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Asahi？」
What was displayed was the sight of Asahi falling to her knees.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh! Sonomi’s strike has finally landed! Is this the end of the match!？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Can't blame her, it's been over 20 minutes since the match started, right？ If she could stand up after that, it'd be a miracle！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「20 minutes？ You've got to be kidding...！」
...Asahi has been fighting this whole time.
While I was just lazing around here, she was fighting against that Arakawa-senpai.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And, and, Sonomi is slowly approaching Asahi！！」
I remembered a nasty scene.
Having my arm grabbed by her... having a blade pressed against my throat. And I was—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi... stand up, you have to stand up...！」
I couldn't bear to watch.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi...！！」
Before I knew it, I was running.

name: Ririmu
message: （Ever since I first met her, I couldn't stand her...！ Always clinging to the teacher, making a fool out of everyone...！）
Above all, I hated that way of hers, prioritizing others over herself. I didn't want to lose to someone like that.
I wanted to make her realize that I was stronger. I still think so even now.

name: Ririmu
message: （But after fighting her, and letting out everything I wanted to say... I feel like I understand Asahi a little better now...！）
Asahi is purely and stubbornly positive about what she believes in. And she can't forgive people who deny that.
Deep down, she wants to express her feelings more, but she can't, and it’s eating away at her.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I know it... that's why you got angry at Arakawa-senpai in my place, isn't it...！」
It’s because you think of me as someone precious, someone you can believe in...！
To have our post-match analysis together, and to say everything to each other without holding back.

name: Ririmu
message: 「You thought of me as your friend, and yet...！ I took it all out on you like that...！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm the absolute biggest idiot！」
I push past the spectators and cling to the very front.
Asahi is still down on her knees, and Arakawa Sonomi is already right in front of her. At this rate, Asahi is going to lose.
Pathetically beaten, just like me.
Not that—anything but seeing Asahi like that.
No way, I refuse—！！！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Y-You... idiot Asahiiiiiiiii！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「How long are you gonna stay sitting there！」
I shouted at the top of my lungs.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi... You're not the kind of person who's supposed to lose here！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You think this is the time to be taking a leisurely nap down there?！！」
I don't care what everyone around me thinks.
Asahi doesn't move. I can't even tell if she hears me.
Still, if I don't say this right now, I'll probably regret it for the rest of my life.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Listen up, I'm only ever gonna say this once...！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi, you're my friend！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I want to keep being your friend forever！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So I'm apologizing—I'm sorry for taking it out on you...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Thank you for getting angry on my behalf！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「When you said, 'Take back what you just said,' I was actually really, really happy！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You really saved me, you know！」
Holding back the tears welling up in my eyes, I force the words out in a scream.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Please... Asahi, stand up！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're gonna become the Toujinegi, aren't you！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're the one who's gonna fulfill Big Bro's dream, aren't you！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're gonna fight for me... since I couldn't even say a single word back, aren't you？！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then you can't lose right here！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi, Asahi...! Please, stand up...!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Avenge！ My！ Loss-----！！」
...I hear a voice.
I don't like this. I hate this more than anything.

name: Asahi
message: （To be told something like that...）

name: Asahi
message: （To have made Ririmu-san say something like that...！）
Words that girl would never say. A desperate plea that she would never normally let pass her lips.
I really am pathetic.
Was I really that weak...？

name: Sonomi
message: 「Alright, it's over...！」
Arakawa-senpai is standing right in front of me. She reaches out an arm toward me, where I'm on my knees.
If she grabs me, it's over. Just like back when Ririmu-san lost in the qualifying match.
So, that hand, I...

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tsk, you brat, still...！？」
Instead―I grabbed Arakawa―senpai’s arm back.

name: Asahi
message: 「...What are you surprised about?」
Arakawa-senpai is bearing down on me with overwhelming power, augmented by her Tenju.

name: Sonomi
message: 「You little—don't get carried away...!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You really think you can match my power...!?」
That Herculean strength that neither Momiji-san nor Ririmu-san could ever pry away.
My arm strength—I’m pushing it back—by force of will！！

name: Asahi
message: 「Do not get cocky, Arakawa-senpai...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Do you really think... that you’re the only one who has been training to their limit...!？」
I plant my feet firmly into the ground. Slowly, I lift my knees up off the floor.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Y-you, such power...！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「You are overestimating your own strength...！」
I take a step forward toward Arakawa-senpai.

name: Asahi
message: 「...You said it to Ririmu-san, didn't you? That she was coddling herself.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then, if someone who has worked harder than you says that to you, what will you do？」
Clutching her arm, I force her back another step.

name: Asahi
message: 「Compared to me, you lack effort. You're too soft on yourself—！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「God damn it...！！」
I catch the blade thrust out in desperation with my own.
While our guards are locked, I push in with the strength of my whole body.

name: Asahi
message: 「What's wrong? Can you not talk back...?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tsk, hnh... yeah, I'll give you that. You've put in just as much, if not more, effort than I have.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You're the real deal...！」
I feel her strength increasing. As if she's trying to force her way through, violently.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Isn't it great, this thing called Jindou...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「During a match, it doesn't matter if you're rich or poor—it's equal...！ Status means jack shit...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「The strong win, and the weak lose. You get stronger if you train, and technique never lies...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That's why... just during a match, I can forget everything and have fun...！」
Arakawa-senpai says this with a laugh, putting even more force into the push.

name: Sonomi
message: 「You're fun, you know... You're the first person who's been able to play along with my games for this long...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I really wish we could just keep playing like this forever...!」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm afraid I have to pass. I want you to bow your head to me as soon as possible...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Don't be like that, come on！！」
A barrage of blows like a ferocious beast—.
Using forceful, raw physical twists and weight shifts, horrifying destructive power comes flying at me on an incomprehensible trajectory.
I parry them one by one.

name: Asahi
message: 「I have understood that you... have your own circumstances.」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, everyone has their circumstances. You, me, and even Ririmu-san...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, don't go spouting off enlightened bullshit！！ Everyone's just moving based on their own selfish logic, aren't they！」
I catch a wide swing aimed at my torso.

name: Asahi
message: 「Always gauging everything only by your own standards, looking down on people, and mocking them—」
I repel her blade and strike back this time！

name: Asahi
message: 「With that narrow-mindedness, you hurt Ririmu-san...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, you mean that friend you were yelling about earlier？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, that's right...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You're going to lose here, and I am going to make you bow your head to Ririmu-san, no matter what it takes...!」
Arakawa-senpai parried my slash and leaped back.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch, is that so...！」
I could hear her teeth grinding. I could see the rage on her face. I could feel more power surging out from within her.

name: Sonomi
message: 「So that means you're just another member of the play-pretend club after all！！」
The impact of her kicking off the ground made me think an explosion had gone off.
The shockwave reached me with that much force.
And in that instant, she was right in front of me.
Dashing as if sliding through the air, she swung back her massive blade—

name: Sonomi
message: 「Get crushed!!!」
The blow she brought down—it was never meant to be dodged in the first place. It was at a speed that made that impossible.
But it could be blocked.

name: Asahi
message: 「Oosode Myoga—！！！」
Arakawa-senpai tried to crush me with even more overwhelming strength. I glared back at her.

name: Asahi
message: 「Do you still not get it, you...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Shut up! Don't you dare act like you know everything!!!」
A second time, a third time—
One full-power strike after another came crashing down. But I caught them all with Oosode Myoga.
Each time, my Barrier Jacket was chipped away, its integrity dwindling.
But it didn't matter. I channeled all the Tenju I could muster.

name: Asahi
message: 「How pitiful. You don't understand anything at all...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Like I care! Get crushed, you brat!!!」

name: Asahi
message: 「What you call 'playing pretend' is the exact same as the hard work you've put in...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you think you're the only one who's special, you're dead wrong...！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Rraaaaargh！」
Still, just a little more...！
I poured even more power into it.

name: Asahi
message: 「Everyone has their own form of effort and their own goals, and if you can't even understand that...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then the least you can do is bow your head！！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Just 'cause I gave you a little recognition, don't go acting all high and mighty and spewing your damn nonsense！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「If you want me to let a swordsman do something, defeat me first！！」
A violent impact, yet my stance remained fixed.
My Barrier Jacket is hanging by a thread, and the blow, which bites deep into my core, is sapping away every last ounce of my stamina.
However, my Tenju is sufficient. All that's left is to wait for that moment—

name: Asahi
message: 「...Very well, then be defeated by me！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「DAAAHHHHHHHHHH！！！」
And finally, that moment arrived.
At the very instant Arakawa―senpai raised her blade―

name: Asahi
message: 「――Geki: Raitei Issen！！！！！」
With heart and soul—.
That strike cut through not only the Barrier Jacket but the Spirit-Type Armament as well.
Not only that, it even severed the blade of her nagamaki—
Arakawa-senpai didn't even let out a scream.
Having lost her Origami and simultaneously losing the power of her Tenju, she simply fell silently to the ground—collapsing.

name: Umpire
message: 「Match over！！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「East side, Arakawa Sonomi's Barrier Jacket confirmed destroyed！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Therefore, West side, Kuki Asahi is the winner!!」
After a brief pause, the declaration of victory and the roar of the crowd echoed out.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, haa... haaa...」
A decisive, lethal flash powered by Tenju poured out to my absolute limit.
Once unleashed, the strength drained from my body all at once. I felt like I would collapse if I didn't keep my footing.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ha, ha... ha... ugh, guh...」
Amidst the cheering, Arakawa-senpai lay face-down, but she tried to get up... unable to do so, she barely managed to roll onto her back.
I walked over to her.
I looked down at Senpai, who was staring at the sky with a face that seemed completely drained of spirit.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ha... what？ Did you come all this way just to laugh at me？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I know how much effort you've put in. I will not deny that, nor will I laugh at you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even if you are someone I despise.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hmph, what pretty words... No matter how hard you try, if you lose, it all amounts to nothing...」

name: Asahi
message: 「'It's all for nothing,' you say? Can't you hear the voices of this audience?」

name: Spectator A
message: 「That was a great match, Arakawa！」

name: Spectator B
message: 「Arakawa-senpai, you were so cool！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sono-chan-senpai, your guts, I was watching them the whole time！ You were the coolest ever！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Whoaaaa！ That was one hell of a heated match！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Somehow, it's making me want to play a round too! Don't you guys have an exhibition match or something?」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「P-please don't step on the table！」
I look around the spectator seats. Everyone was sending applause my way.
But it wasn't meant for me alone.
Arakawa-senpai remained looking up at the sky, expressionless. She wouldn't even meet my eyes.
Yet, she muttered, as if whispering to herself.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...I'm already sick of hearing your preaching.」
Saying that, she tried to get up slowly. I reached out to help, but she brushed me off.

name: Sonomi
message: 「But still. That match with you, it was... not bad.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Arakawa-senpai.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I've exposed myself in such a miserable state in front of this whole crowd.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Just let this be my apology to you.」
Saying that—she descended from the stage amidst the cheers and applause.
